Title: Live performance metrics and live deployments in Azure Monitor for containers

Body.Content:
Live performance metrics and live deployments are now available. Together with the live events and live logs features, you can now get a near real-time performance and health view of your AKS cluster and troubleshoot issues faster. The live performance metrics give you near real-time CPU and memory usage of your containers, while the live deployment feature gives you direct access to kubectl get deployments and kubectl describe deployment data in Azure portal for your AKS clusters.
